title: ValueWeave.in — State & District Master Data (Telangana & Andhra Pradesh)
profile: P1 — Government Registry & Statistical Source (per ValueWeave Data Collection & Governance Framework)
layer: Layer I — District Intelligent Digital Infrastructure

resources.name: district
resources.official_standard_body: State Government District Notifications; Census of India 2011; AP Directorate of Economics & Statistics

sources.name: Telangana State Portal
sources.license: Government of Telangana content — license terms not directly confirmed in this pass; treat as Government Open Data pending explicit confirmation (see report, Part 5-equivalent note)

sources.name: Census of India 2011
sources.license: Government of India Open Data (per National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy, 2012) — attribution required
sources.caveat: 2011 is the last completed Census; 2021 Census was delayed/not yet conducted at time of collection — all population-derived figures are ~15 years old and should be treated as a baseline, not current state.

sources.name: AP Districts (Formation) Act notifications (2022; amended Dec 2025)
sources.type: Government Notification (accessed via secondary compilation, not the primary gazette in this pass)
sources.license: Unknown — primary gazette not yet directly fetched; Wikipedia text itself is CC BY-SA 4.0 but the underlying government notification's own license was not confirmed in this pass
sources.caveat: District count changed from 26 to 28 on 31 Dec 2025 (Polavaram and Markapuram added). Area/population for these two new districts are explicitly marked by the source as pending official update.

sources.name: AP Directorate of Economics & Statistics — Socio-Economic Survey 2022-23
sources.license: Government of AP publication — treat as Government Open Data pending explicit confirmation
used_for: population, area for AP districts (as apportioned to 2022 boundaries; NOT yet re-apportioned for the Dec-2025 Polavaram/Markapuram split)

sources.name: Wikipedia — List of districts of Telangana / List of districts of Andhra Pradesh
used_for: structured table compilation of the above official sources; used as the retrieval mechanism, not as an independent authority
sources.caveat: Used because it compiles official-source data into a structured, machine-readable table faster than manually parsing government PDFs; every figure traces to a cited official source, but this pass has not yet independently re-verified each figure directly against the primary gazette/portal. Flagged for direct primary-source confirmation before promotion to VST-VERIFIED.

known_data_conflicts.conflict: Andhra Pradesh district count: multiple pre-Dec-2025 sources state 26 districts; current authoritative count is 28.
known_data_conflicts.resolution: 28 adopted as authoritative, per AP Cabinet decision dated 29 Dec 2025 (effective 31 Dec 2025), corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting and the updated Wikipedia district table.

known_data_conflicts.conflict: Source table (Wikipedia, compiling AP govt data) assigns the same government code 'ANA' to both Anakapalli and Ananthapuramu districts.
known_data_conflicts.resolution: Treated as a transcription error in the secondary compilation. ValueWeave assigns AP-ANK (Anakapalli) and AP-ATP (Ananthapuramu) to preserve code uniqueness, pending direct confirmation against the official AP government gazette/district-code notification.
known_data_conflicts.confidence_in_resolution: Medium — recommend explicit verification against the primary gazette before treating as final.

overall_dataset_confidence.state_records: 82.5 (average of 2 rows) — Tier: below the 85 acceptance threshold recommended for Profile P1/Tier-1 data in the Governance Framework; held at VST-NEEDS_REVIEW
overall_dataset_confidence.district_records_telangana: 88 (all 33 rows) — meets the ≥85 Tier-1 threshold; still held at VST-NEEDS_REVIEW pending LGD code and geocoding completion, not a quality failure
overall_dataset_confidence.district_records_andhra_pradesh: 73.75 (average of 28 rows, range 55–75) — BELOW the 85 Tier-1 threshold; recommend holding this state's district batch out of production until the primary AP gazette is directly fetched and the two newest districts' statistics are confirmed
